items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: At the music box, he'd wait there every night... You can hear him picking for about two blocks... It would be John Marrera and Puy Saville.

ctx.x: The most I heard of him, he's been at the music box, you see?

At the music box, he'd wait there every night, I was at the farm to basically go take a walk. You can hear him picking for about two blocks. The music box was upstairs, you can hear him. He was a wonderful banjo. He's a one-on-one, you know he used to have these, like at the Pelican they'd have a band here and a band there, opposite. Yeah. Well they used to call themselves cutting heads, you see. It would be John Marrera and Puy Saville. John couldn't pick no banjo with him. That man was terrific. He was from…
Rennie Hall, was he a New Orleans band? Right, Born in Red, right there. Is he related to any other Hall that we've been going around?
